name: Coonawarra

climate: Seasons this mild ripen Merlot, Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon, Riesling and Chardonnay fully without cooking off their freshness.
Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah and Merlot sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

soil.rock: Sand is warm and airy. It drains fast but holds little water, and phylloxera does not thrive in it.
soil.top: The topsoil stores water through dry spells, but stays wet and cold after rain, which slows ripening and can swell the grapes. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Mostly flat. Easy and cheap to farm by machine, but on still nights cold air settles on flat ground, so spring frost is a bigger risk.

winkler: Early and mid-season grapes make good wine.
